## Featured Projects

1. **EVER 5th Generation** (Robotics / Autonomous Driving)
   - Description: AI-powered autonomous truck system combining machine learning, PID controllers, and computer vision for intelligent lane changes.
   - Technologies: Python, ROS, Autonomous Driving, Computer Vision.
   - Repository: https://github.com/ZiadMD/EVER_CLoseLoop

2. **NASA 2025 — TERRA** (AI / Climate Science)
   - Description: Educational web platform using Scikit-learn ML models to predict climate patterns from NASA data, featuring a Gemini API chatbot and interactive simulation game.
   - Technologies: Next.js, TypeScript, Scikit-learn, Gemini API.
   - Live Demo: https://spatuim.vercel.app/
   - Repository: https://github.com/ZiadMD/Nasa-2025

3. **Cat-Dog Classifier** (Deep Learning / Desktop Application)
   - Description: PySide6 desktop application using TensorFlow for real-time image classification with custom deep learning models.
   - Technologies: Python, PySide6, TensorFlow, Deep Learning.
   - Repository: https://github.com/ZiadMD/cat-dog-classifier

4. **Qt-Cascade-app** (Computer Vision / Desktop)
   - Description: Real-time desktop object detection application built with C++, Qt, and OpenCV using Haar cascade classifiers.
   - Technologies: C++, Qt, OpenCV, Computer Vision.
   - Repository: https://github.com/ZiadMD/Qt-Cascade-app

5. **Numerical Analysis App** (Scientific Computing / C++)
   - Description: Linux-optimized C++17 application implementing numerical analysis algorithms with a Qt6 GUI for root finding and curve fitting.
   - Technologies: C++, Qt, Linux.
   - Repository: https://github.com/ZiadMD/Numerical-Analysis-project

6. **Library Management System (LMS)** (Software Engineering / Algorithms)
   - Description: High-performance data structure management system in C++ using doubly linked lists with custom sorting and searching algorithms.
   - Technologies: C++, Data Structures, Algorithms.
   - Repository: https://github.com/ZiadMD/LMS

7. **AuthMaster** (Security / Python)
   - Description: Desktop authentication system with Python Tkinter featuring SHA-256 password hashing and secure user verification.
   - Technologies: Python, GUI, SHA-256 Hashing.
   - Repository: https://github.com/ZiadMD/AuthMaster
